summary: LanzaTech Global, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement on May 15, 2026, for a registered direct offering of 2,000,000 shares at $10.00 per share, raising $20 million gross. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration statement (Form S-3), not a special situation. The company expects the offering to close May 18, 2026, and intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes. No special-situation elements such as activism, restructuring, or strategic review are present.
